_comment: Tier-2 for skfem heat#5. The existing heat::0 fixture checks that a short x raises 'out of bounds'; this one pins the ARITHMETIC of the message and finds the asymmetry the claim does not mention. Measured on skfem 12.0.1 (MeshQuad 5x5, ElementQuad1, left+right constrained): a short x of length len(D)=10 raises IndexError 'index 20 is out of bounds for axis 0 with size 10' -- the index is a GLOBAL DOF number and the size is len(x), which is why the numbers look unrelated to the BC. A too-LONG x does NOT raise at all: it is silently accepted and the extra entries ignored.
expect_in_output: out of bounds for axis 0 with size 10
